claims.text: Java SE 21 documents rejection when the executor is shut down or when both maximum threads and work-queue capacity are finite and the executor is saturated; execute then invokes RejectedExecutionHandler.rejectedExecution, with four predefined policies.

Java SE 21 documents AbortPolicy throwing RejectedExecutionException, CallerRunsPolicy running the task in the execute-calling thread as feedback slowing submissions, DiscardPolicy silently dropping the task only when completion is never relied upon, and DiscardOldestPolicy dropping the work-queue head then retrying and being rarely acceptable; AbortPolicy is the default handler.

Java SE 21 documents that CallerRunsPolicy discards when the executor is shut down, and that DiscardOldestPolicy discards the queue head then retries unless shutdown, potentially repeating failure; its documentation advises cancellation/logging in nearly all cases.

unsupported_claims.claim: AbortPolicy 是默认构造器使用的策略
unsupported_claims.reason: Java SE 21 只说明未显式传入 handler 的特定 ThreadPoolExecutor 构造器使用默认拒绝处理器，不存在对应的无参默认构造器表述。

unsupported_claims.claim: CallerRunsPolicy 不适合递归提交任务
unsupported_claims.reason: 现有一手证据只支持调用 execute 的线程执行任务并形成降速反馈，未覆盖该适用性结论。

findings: 四个预置策略、拒绝触发、CallerRuns shutdown 边界和 DiscardOldest 队首重试均已核验。
两轮审查后仍有未经映射的构造器/递归提交结论，并且核心结论口述密度过高；保持 needs_update，禁止第三轮修订。
